units.source_text: 入夜，赴京的使者左卫门大夫时方回来了。

en.t: After nightfall, Tokikata, the Saemon no Taifu who had gone as a messenger to the capital, returned.

units.source_text: 他找到右近，报道：“明石皇后也派使者来探询亲王下落，

en.t: He found Ukon and reported, "The Akashi Empress also sent a messenger to ask after the prince's whereabouts,

units.source_text: 他说皇后非常着急，说道：‘左大臣也在生气。

en.t: and he said that the Empress was extremely worried, adding, 'The Minister of the Left is angry as well.

units.source_text: 亲王对谁也不告知，擅自出游，举止实太轻率，且亦难保无意外之虞。

en.t: For the prince to go off on an outing without telling anyone is truly careless conduct, and there is no telling what accident might occur.

units.source_text: 倘被皇上闻知，我等难辞其咎。’

en.t: If His Majesty hears of it, we will not be able to escape blame.'

units.source_text: 我对人说：‘亲王到东山去探望一位高僧了。’”

en.t: I told people, 'The prince has gone to Higashiyama to visit a venerable monk.'"

units.source_text: 接着时方又说：“女人真是罪孽深重的东西啊！

en.t: Then Tokikata went on, "Women really are sinful creatures!

units.source_text: 害得我们这种非亲非故的人也受累，还逼得我说谎。”

en.t: They drag even unrelated people like us into trouble, and even force me to lie."

units.source_text: 右近说：“你把女人说成高僧，好极好极！

en.t: Ukon said, "Calling a woman a venerable monk was splendid, truly splendid!

units.source_text: 这点功德足可抵消你说谎的罪过了！

en.t: That small act of merit is more than enough to offset the sin of your lie!

units.source_text: 你家亲王的性情实在奇怪，怎么会有这种脾气的？

en.t: Your prince really does have a strange nature. How did he come to have such a temperament?

units.source_text: 如果我们预先知道他要来，那么此事关系重大，我们一定设法对付。

en.t: If we had known in advance that he was coming, we would certainly have found some way to deal with it, since the matter is so serious.

units.source_text: 这样蛮不讲理，突如其来，叫我们怎么办呢！”

en.t: But when he arrives so unreasonably and so suddenly, what are we supposed to do!"

units.source_text: 她如此应对之后，便回进去见匂亲王，把时方的话如实传达。

en.t: After answering him in this way, she went back inside to see Prince Niou and conveyed Tokikata's words exactly as they were.

units.source_text: 匂亲王原已料到京中为他非常着急，

en.t: Prince Niou had already expected that people in the capital would be very worried about him,

units.source_text: 但他对浮舟说道：“我为身份所拘，行动不能自由，太痛苦了！

en.t: but he said to Ukifune, "I am bound by my rank and cannot move freely. It is unbearable!

units.source_text: 但愿做个平凡的殿上人，即使暂时也好。

en.t: I wish I could be an ordinary courtier, even if only for a little while.

units.source_text: 像这种应该顾虑的事情，我一向肆无忌惮，怎么办呢？

en.t: Even in matters like this, where I ought to show restraint, I always act without hesitation. What am I to do?

units.source_text: 倘被薰大将知道了，不知他作何感想。

en.t: If General Kaoru learns of this, I do not know what he will think.

units.source_text: 我同他原是近亲，加之从小就是知己朋友，

en.t: He and I are close relatives to begin with, and on top of that we have been intimate friends since childhood,

units.source_text: 现在我做出这种伤情背义的事情来，被他知道了，我多么不好意思！

en.t: so if he learns that I have now done something so hurtful and disloyal, how ashamed I will be!

units.source_text: 今后又如何见面呢？

en.t: How could I face him again after this?

units.source_text: 我还想到：世人有‘责人则明，恕己则昏’之说，

en.t: I also thought of the saying that people see clearly when blaming others but are blind when forgiving themselves,

units.source_text: 深恐薰大将不知道自己劳人盼待之罪，而责备你不贞。

en.t: and I deeply fear that General Kaoru, unaware of his own fault in making you wait and suffer, will blame you for being unfaithful.

units.source_text: 所以我想带你离开此地，迁居到绝无人知的别处去。”

en.t: That is why I want to take you away from here and move somewhere else where absolutely no one knows us."

units.source_text: 匂亲王今天不便再通宵闭居在这里，只得准备回京，

en.t: Prince Niou could not very well stay shut up here through the entire night again today, so he had no choice but to prepare to return to the capital,

units.source_text: 然而他的灵魂似乎已经落入浮舟怀袖中了。

en.t: yet his soul seemed already to have fallen into Ukifune's breast and sleeves.

units.source_text: 天色尚未明亮之时，他的随从人员在外面咳嗽，表示催促动身。

en.t: Before the sky had yet grown light, his attendants coughed outside as a signal urging him to depart.

units.source_text: 匂亲王携着浮舟的手来到边门口，并不立刻出去，吟诗曰：

en.t: Prince Niou took Ukifune's hand and came to the side gate, but he did not go out at once, and recited this poem:
